# Action Plan Status Flow

Source: `08-ScenarioTest.md` and the whiteboard (image below, drawn in `11-WhiteboardFlow.md`), checked against
`ActionPlanApprovalService.cs` on `feat/action-plan-al-wt` (Design A, decided 18 Nov 2026).

Two fields are shown on every plan:

- **Approval status** = `approval_status` on the plan: `waiting_review`, `modify_in_approval`, `reject_in_approval`, `approved`, `rejected`.
- **Action plan status** = `progress` for the list: `need_review` while `waiting_review` (with the PO); `routing` while `modify_in_approval` or `reject_in_approval`; `rejected` when `rejected`; else derived from the start date: `on_schedule` (starts today, later, or no date) or `overdue` (start date passed). No `upcoming`. Current level = `approval.current_level` (integer).

Approval route (Data Config, one per source + type):

- The route holds the **manager levels only** (Manager 1 → Manager 2), for Modify and Reject alike.
- **Modify round:** the backend appends the plan's **SSDP creator** as the last level (only the creator; the PO may not put
  them on a manager level → 400). The creator answers with the same level endpoints, without the 162 / 163 privilege.
- **Reject round:** managers only.

## 1. Approval status state machine

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> waiting_review: SSDP submit, PO pool notified

    waiting_review --> approved: PO approve (direct)
    waiting_review --> modify_in_approval: PO modify (level 1 opens)
    waiting_review --> reject_in_approval: PO reject (level 1 opens)

    modify_in_approval --> modify_in_approval: level approve, next level exists
    modify_in_approval --> approved: last level (SSDP) approve, proposal applied
    modify_in_approval --> waiting_review: any level reject (SSDP included), proposal dropped

    reject_in_approval --> reject_in_approval: level agrees (approval/reject), next level exists
    reject_in_approval --> rejected: last level agrees
    reject_in_approval --> waiting_review: level asks PO to modify (approval/modify)

    approved --> [*]
    rejected --> [*]
```

Notes:

- `modify_returned` and `waiting_ssdp_review` do not exist. Every "back to PO" is `waiting_review`.
- From `waiting_review` the PO can approve, modify or reject, also after a return (decided 18 Nov, wider than the whiteboard).
  Race-safe: the PO decision claims the plan with a conditional UPDATE (`waiting_review` + same round) inside its transaction;
  a second concurrent decision gets 400 "decided by someone else, please reload". Level decisions already claim the level.
- Reject round: `approval/approve` answers 400. "Agree to reject" is `approval/reject`; "Ask PO to Modify" is `approval/modify`.
- Every level decision is for the pending level only (`approval.current_level`).

## 2. Scenario paths

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    S[SSDP submit] --> W[waiting_review<br/>need_review]

    W -->|Test 1: PO approve| A1[approved<br/>SSDP: In Progress]
    W -->|Test 2: PO modify| M1[modify_in_approval<br/>level 1 Manager 1]
    W -->|Test 3: PO reject| R1[reject_in_approval<br/>level 1 Manager 1]

    M1 -->|L1 approve| M2[modify_in_approval<br/>level 2 Manager 2]
    M2 -->|L2 approve| M3[modify_in_approval<br/>level 3 SSDP]
    M3 -->|SSDP approve| A2[approved<br/>proposal applied]

    M1 -->|Test 2.1: L1 reject| W
    M2 -->|Test 2.2: L2 reject| W
    M3 -->|SSDP reject| W

    R1 -->|Test 3: L1 agrees| R2[reject_in_approval<br/>level 2 Manager 2]
    R2 -->|Test 3: L2 agrees| RJ[rejected<br/>terminal]
    R1 -->|Test 3.1: L1 asks PO to modify| W
    R2 -->|Test 3.2: L2 asks PO to modify| W
```

Test 3.2 here is the original case from `08-ScenarioTest.copy-2026-11-17.md` (Reject round: Manager 1 agrees, Manager 2 asks
the PO to modify), with "PO will reject" instead of "PO will modify".

## 3. Scenario → expected status

| Test | Step | Action plan status (progress) | Approval status | Current level | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | SSDP submit | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | PO pool notified |
| 1 | PO approve | `on_schedule` | `approved` | - | SSDP submitter: "Well Test / Artificial Lift In Progress" |
| 2 | PO modify | `routing` | `modify_in_approval` | 1 | Manager 1 notified |
| 2 | L1 approve | `routing` | `modify_in_approval` | 2 | Manager 2 notified |
| 2 | L2 approve | `routing` | `modify_in_approval` | 3 | SSDP creator (level 3) notified, SSDP copy |
| 2 | SSDP approve | `on_schedule` | `approved` | - | Proposal applied; PO pool + SSDP submitter: In Progress |
| 2.1 | L1 reject | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | Proposal dropped; PO pool: "modify rejected" |
| 2.2 | L1 approve, L2 reject | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | Same as 2.1 |
| 2 (SSDP reject) | L1, L2 approve, SSDP reject | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | Same as 2.1 (PHI-2256 / PHI-2401) |
| 3 | PO reject | `routing` | `reject_in_approval` | 1 | Manager 1 notified |
| 3 | L1 agrees (`approval/reject`) | `routing` | `reject_in_approval` | 2 | Manager 2 notified |
| 3 | L2 agrees (`approval/reject`) | `rejected` | `rejected` | - | Terminal; PO pool + SSDP creator: "Action Plan Rejected by Manager" |
| 3.1 | L1 asks PO to modify (`approval/modify`) | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | PO pool: "reject rejected" |
| 3.2 | L1 agrees, L2 asks PO to modify | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | Same as 3.1 |
| no-approval | SSDP submit | from start date | `approved` | - | No WO, no notification, no PO task |
| WHC | SSDP submit | `need_review` | `waiting_review` | - | PO gets "Artificial Lift Request" |
| WHC | PO approve | `on_schedule` | `approved` | - | SSDP: "Artificial Lift In Progress" |
| WHC | PO modify → L1 → L2 → SSDP approve | `on_schedule` | `approved` | - | SSDP level gets "Artificial Lift Installation has been modified by <department>" |

## 4. Task and review visibility per status

| Approval status | Review request list (PO pool, permission 161) | Approval request list (level holder) | can_review |
|---|---|---|---|
| `waiting_review` | yes | - | PO pool only |
| `modify_in_approval` | - | pending level only (SSDP at the last level) | false |
| `reject_in_approval` | - | pending level only | false |
| `approved` / `rejected` | - | - | false |

`can_approve` / `can_reject` are true only for the pending level (162 / 163), or for the SSDP creator on the last Modify
level (no privilege needed). In a Reject round `can_approve` is false and
`can_reject` covers both `approval/reject` and `approval/modify`.

The detail has `can_review`; every list row (PEP + PHSS) has `is_can_review`, with the same rule. The list also takes `is_can_review=true`
(only the rows the caller can review now, the same set as `need-action?stage=review` for that source) or `is_can_review=false`.

  `approvers`.
- **PO notification copy:** the PO pool gets the existing "[action_type] In Progress" template on the final Modify approval
  (ocean-email-template has no "modify approved" copy). Add a dedicated template there if the PO needs other wording.
